think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and data type from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it has enumerated ‘magic’ numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch it into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/sentinel behavior) rather than simply scaling cost. 3) Verify the documented valid range and default, and whether any boundary value is described as a special mode. 4) Classify as ‘special’ only if such sentinel values exist; otherwise treat as a regular numeric knob.
